script: Making fresh pasta at home is easier than you think. Pour flour onto a wooden board and make a well in the middle. Crack eggs into the well and whisk them gently with a fork. Slowly pull the flour into the eggs until a dough forms. Knead the dough with your hands for ten minutes until it is smooth. Wrap it and let it rest. Then roll it thin with a rolling pin and cut it into ribbons. Drop the pasta into boiling water for two minutes and serve it with tomato sauce and basil.
